meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 它会按 6 阶段流程为你的商品产出带货视频脚本:先收集商品与人群信息,再按「痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决」写分镜,并给出镜头运镜和字幕、配乐等后期建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频脚本,或需要电商视频营销方面的指导时触发。

say.text: 给我写一个30秒自动喂食器的抖音带货脚本
say.note: 它会先向你收集商品与人群信息

say.text: 用科技感风格为智能厨电写一个60秒脚本
say.note: 输出按痛点、产品展示、痛点解决结构

say.text: 帮我给护肤品脚本设计镜头类型和运镜方式
say.note: 会给出镜头选择与运镜建议

howto.what_en: It runs a 6-stage process to produce e-commerce video scripts: collect product and audience info, write shots in a pain point to product demo to resolution structure, then suggest camera moves, subtitles and music.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a product video script for platforms like Douyin or Xiaohongshu, or want e-commerce video marketing guidance.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin script for an automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: It first asks for product and audience details

say_en.text: Use a tech style for a 60-second smart kitchen appliance script
say_en.note: Output follows pain point, demo, resolution

say_en.text: Design the shot types and camera moves for a skincare script
say_en.note: You get shot and camera movement suggestions
